title: I got Banned

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello SavageStrafe,

You were banned for "Ban Evasion," meaning that the staff member who banned you believed that SAGEMASTER564 was avoiding his ban by using your account. However, seeing as your IPs do not match enough to be eligible for ban evasion, it is believable that you are not the user, SAGEMASTER564, and that you merely know him. Therefore, your appeal will be accepted. Make sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back to the server.

Regards,
Rinn | Senior Moderator
